subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / technical deep dive - FinPath
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up & next steps from today

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier today. The team is excited about Redwood's approach to lowering inference cost while keeping latency predictable. Quick recap of what we discussed on our side:
- Primary use case: customer-facing chat that needs sub-200ms p95 for short queries (~256 tokens).
- Scale: targeting ~30 qps during peak; currently evaluating batching/quantization tradeoffs.
- Data concerns: PII handling and audit logs are important — our security team will want to run a questionnaire.

Next steps we’d like:
1) Technical deep dive / demo focused on runtime and security integration (KV cache, quantization options, VPC/private deployment).
2) Loop in procurement so we can align on pricing and potential reserved capacity.

Can you share some windows for next week (we’re in PST)? Also please loop in whoever from your side should be at the deep dive (SE + security).

I’ll also add Jordan (procurement) on follow-up.

Thanks,
Emily
Director of Product
FinPath
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@finpath.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & next steps from today

Hi Emily — great to hear, and thanks for the clear recap.

Recap (from our side):
- We’ll run a technical deep dive / demo that covers: runtime architecture, latency profiles, batching/quantization recommendations, VPC/private deployment options, and audit/logging capabilities.
- Nikhil (SE) will drive the deep dive; Vivek (security) can walk through our SOC/controls and the questionnaire.

Proposed windows (all PST):
- Tue 26 Oct, 10:00–11:30 (recommended for full team)
- Wed 27 Oct, 09:00–10:00 (shorter demo + Q/A)
- Thu 28 Oct, 14:00–15:30 (alternate)

Attachments: I’ve attached a lightweight mutual_action_plan.xlsx and our security_questionnaire.pdf to help your team prep. I’m also attaching a draft SOW (redwood_sow_v1.pdf) for procurement to review — happy to iterate.

If any of those slots work, reply with your preferred time and I’ll send a calendar invite and a DocuSign for the SOW.

Thanks — looping Nikhil and Vivek to confirm availability.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@finpath.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & next steps from today

Thanks Marissa — I can do Tue 26 Oct 10:00–11:30 or Thu 28 Oct 14:00–15:30.

For the deep dive, I’ll plan for a 60–90 minute session that includes:
- Demo of single-request latency and p95 measurements with synthetic traces
- Batching and KV cache behavior for streamed chat workloads
- Quantization impact on throughput/latency and suggested profiles for your hardware targets
- Q/A and next steps for a POC (we can propose a small pilot config)

Prep items for FinPath if possible: sample token-length distribution (anonymized) and any firewall/VPC constraints.

I’ll be ready to share a brief runbook and slides during the session.

-Nikhil
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
